runs.final_sql: SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM drvr d JOIN lp_tm l ON l.ref1 = d.drvr_id WHERE d.ntnl = 'German' AND YEAR(d.db) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990 GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm ORDER BY MIN(l.tm) ASC LIMIT 3
sql_history: SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, MIN(l.tm) AS earliest_lap_time FROM drvr d JOIN lp_tm l ON l.ref1 = d.drvr_id WHERE d.ntnl = 'German' AND YEAR(d.db) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990 GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm ORDER BY earliest_lap_time ASC LIMIT 3

runs.final_sql: SELECT r.fsts_lp_tm AS lap_record FROM rslt r JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE d.frnm = 'Lewis' AND d.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND r.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL AND r.fsts_lp_tm <> '' ORDER BY r.fsts_lp_tm ASC LIMIT 1;
